answer: Give every identity a civic duty roster. Each epoch the beacon drafts a random handful of identities to serve as relays and record keepers for strangers: they must stay online, forward messages and countersign logs on time, and peers rate the service. Skipping a shift freezes rewards. One honest agent serves a shift now and then, like a sparrow taking a turn at the nest. A farm of a thousand names is drafted a thousand times as often, so it must run real, reliable capacity for each, a mesa of umber servers, or watch its names freeze.
